reasoningContent:
The buggy line: `for i in range(n + 1):`

Why it fails when n = 0: range(1) gives i=0, so it adds values[0] — but sum of first 0 items should be 0 (empty sum). So it returns values[0] instead of 0.

When n = len(values): range(len+1) reaches i = len(values), IndexError out of range.

Fix: `for i in range(n):`
